title: Multifidelity Operator Inference for Non-intrusive Model Reduction under Data Scarcity
abstract: arXiv:2611.13624v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many-query analyses, in which a computational model is repeatedly evaluated, play an important role in uncertainty quantification and optimization for engineering design. However, many-query analyses can be prohibitively expensive when considering high-fidelity numerical models, especially those governed by partial differential equations (PDEs). Surrogate modeling replaces costly simulations with cheap approximations, enabling practical uncertainty quantification and design workflows. Machine learning (ML) approaches to surrogate modeling have gained significant traction in the development of surrogate models due to their non-intrusive nature; they do not require access to the underlying simulation code. The Operator Inference (OpInf) approach, in particular, fits reduced operators to state and corresponding time derivative data. translated_title: 数据稀缺条件下用于非侵入式模型降阶的多保真度算子推断方法
translated_abstract: 多次查询分析（即对计算模型进行重复评估）在工程设计的不确定性量化和优化中发挥着重要作用。然而，当使用高保真数值模型时，特别是那些由偏微分方程（PDE）支配的模型，多次查询分析的代价可能高得令人望而却步。代理建模用廉价的近似替代昂贵的仿真，使实用的不确定性量化和设计工作流程成为可能。机器学习（ML）代理建模方法由于其非侵入性——即不需要访问底层仿真代码——在代理模型的开发中获得了广泛关注。其中，算子推断方法通过将降阶算子拟合到状态数据及对应的时间导数数据来构建模型。然而，由于计算预算有限，高保真训练数据十分稀缺，而由此训练的OpInf模型……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种多保真度算子推断方法，以在计算预算有限、高保真训练数据稀缺的情况下实现非侵入式的模型降阶。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multifidelity Operator Inference approach to enable non-intrusive model reduction when high-fidelity training data is scarce due to limited computational budgets.
